name: @KING/seemath
description: A Claude Code plugin: a collection of education skills that turn academic problems into interactive lesson web pages and explainer videos. Skills: seemath-solid-geometry (solid geometry, coordinate+vector method, 3D Three.js + MathJax), seemath-analytic-geometry (conic sections, exact sympy-driven solutions with a live interactive 2D Canvas board + KaTeX), seemath-chem-reaction (microscopic 3D chemistry reaction demos — sympy-balanced, atom-conservation morph + mechanism engines, Three.js + KaTeX), and seemath-math-video (math problem explainer videos — Chinese GLM-TTS voice-over, bilingual zh+en subtitles, hand-drawn canvas animation rendered to MP4).
author: JSH (@akokoi1) (https://x.com/akokoi1)
